scope: Optional SCREENSHOT_GUEST_RELOAD=1 and SCREENSHOT_ROLE_CHANGE=1 paths in the existing guest acceptance runner.

findings.evidence: The runner sends Page.reload to its owned side-panel target, requires a new main-frame loader ID, then requires the uniquely selected linked Chat pane, guest avatar, and absence of Screenshots trigger, pane, and capture buttons.

The runner uses the real web login form and extension Account sign-in, verifies admin identity, selects the real Screenshots trigger with linked mounted view, opens the avatar menu, clicks its Sign out button, and requires same-panel guest Chat recovery with protected navigation and content absent. It does not write auth or tab storage directly.

UserMenu invokes useAuth.signOut; use-auth calls auth/flow.signOut. That path clears this extension profile's session and sends only POST /auth/v1/logout?scope=local with the captured bearer. clearSupabaseSession clears Realtime auth rather than issuing a global sign-out. The local logout request is an intentional auth side effect of the real UI action.

The runner records receipt/manifest version and tree SHA-256 before launch; the native harness verifies actual unpacked tree, receipt, expected extension and newly owned profile. After execution the runner checks receipt/manifest identity and rehashes the unpacked tree, then records extension ID.

No product screenshot capture, save, delete, direct tab-state mutation, Chat send, or Pilot action is scripted. Initial Chat is observed as the default guest landing. SEO can cause the product's automatic read-only audit/history requests. Failure-only PNG evidence is exclusively created in private mode 0600.

remaining: A guarded native run with both flags is required to establish guest reload and stale-selection recovery in the real panel. Source acceptance is not runtime proof.
